decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed two storey side extension, single storey rear extension and part first floor rear extension, would be acceptable due to its position, design and appearance. The development would not harm the appearance of the area, neighbours' living conditions or highway safety and complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 	(Extensions and Alterations) and 1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 12 Trinity Close.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am  to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am  to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north-eastern or south-western walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of two storey side extension, ground floor rear extension and part first floor rear extension to house.
